candidate_events.title: Initial graph-to-rule implementation skeleton established
candidate_events.summary: The repository work order and first implementation sequence added data contracts, metadata, candidate-universe and masked graph extraction, relation profiling, a rule DSL, template construction, a deterministic verifier, a deterministic runtime, and a synthetic end-to-end feasibility path.

candidate_events.title: SWaT staging milestone bounded as implementation evidence
candidate_events.summary: The TASK-017 through TASK-021 staging sequence demonstrated local pipeline plumbing and synthetic runtime behavior but explicitly excluded official benchmark, anomaly-performance, explanation-quality, and final thesis claims.

candidate_events.title: ARGOS reproduction audit track opened
candidate_events.summary: TASK-022 and TASK-023 added a pinned ARGOS paper-code audit protocol and offline reproduction harness. The reports explicitly withheld any claim of faithful reproduction or real LLM validation.

candidate_events.title: Multivariate CPS contract path defined
candidate_events.summary: TASK-030 through TASK-032F added the multivariate CPS extension contract and a deterministic synthetic vertical slice from serialized mappings through verification, runtime authorization, traces, and explanations. The result remained synthetic contract plumbing only.

candidate_events.title: ARGOS reference track frozen as partial methodological support
candidate_events.summary: TASK-038F classified the ARGOS evidence as partial methodological support, not exact reproduction or proposed-method validation, and recommended freezing the reference track while directing primary work toward the graph-guided verifier-governed multivariate CPS method.

candidate_events.title: Initial official HAI provenance attempt preserved as blocked
candidate_events.summary: The first TASK-039A lineage preserved an acquisition block and a blocked Git-LFS provenance result before the later selective-payload remediation.

candidate_events.title: HAI 23.05 official provenance verified
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039AR established byte equivalence for the ten approved files and TASK-039A passed official HAI 23.05 source, integrity, schema, label-custody, and public-provenance audit boundaries.

candidate_events.title: Original binary-discrete delayed-response feasibility blocked
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039B recorded zero eligible reviewed nonconstant binary or discrete control sources for P1 and P3, selected no process, and froze the result as blocked rather than weakening the gate.

candidate_events.title: Continuous-step delayed-response recovery route selected
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039BR0 diagnosed the source-morphology mismatch and recommended versioned continuous-step delayed-response semantics on HAI while keeping the blocked TASK-039B result unchanged.

candidate_events.title: Continuous-step relation protocol preregistered
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039BR1 froze continuous_step_delayed_response_v1 and a normal-only P1/P3 feasibility protocol without real HAI feature access, process selection, rule generation, or runtime authority.

candidate_events.title: P1 Boiler selected by frozen feasibility gate
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039BR2 executed the preregistered normal-only train1-train3 protocol. P1 alone passed and was selected with reason only_P1_feasible; P3 remained infeasible.

candidate_events.title: P1 feasibility result independently audited
candidate_events.summary: The read-only TASK-039BR2 audit verified lineage, protocol compliance, private-ledger bindings, aggregate reconstruction, P1 selection, and zero prohibited accesses without rerunning real HAI feasibility.

candidate_events.title: Three-arm P1 candidate-discovery protocol frozen
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039C0 froze a 144-pair P1 universe with separate META, STAT, and upstream-aligned GDN candidate arms and unscored-union integration boundaries.

candidate_events.title: META STAT and GDN candidate cohort frozen
candidate_events.summary: The three candidate arms were integrated without a merged score or global rank, producing a frozen cohort of 47 unique candidate identities.

candidate_events.title: Normal relation profiling executed after complexity recovery
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039D1R repaired a non-scientific repeated whole-sequence validation cost while preserving formulas, then executed normal relation fit profiling; the later D2 confirmation stage was independently audited.

candidate_events.title: Construction evidence materialized for 42 relations
candidate_events.summary: TASK-039E1 materialized and independently audited 42 confirmed directional relation primitives across 23 pair contexts, with 42 private evidence records and frozen normal-only numeric references; no rules or LLM calls occurred in this stage.

candidate_events.title: Rule-construction arm result analyzed
candidate_events.summary: The frozen construction analysis reported 42 of 42 admissible relations for T0, T1, and T1-B, 39 of 42 for T2, and zero activated T2 feedback actions. It explicitly rejected an empirical superiority claim for the feedback agent and required utility evaluation.

candidate_events.title: Rule-utility protocol and thesis framing checkpointed
candidate_events.summary: The utility protocol was frozen and independently audited, and thesis documents consolidated the construction result while keeping utility unexecuted at that checkpoint.

candidate_events.title: COMMON-42 and normal-only numeric authority restored
candidate_events.summary: The authority audit confirmed one frozen executable COMMON-42 portfolio for T0, T1, and T1-B semantics, with T2 aggregate coverage of 39 accepted and 3 no_rule, followed by materialization and independent audit of normal-only numeric authority.

candidate_events.title: First INNER D1 Rule-only result executed and audited
candidate_events.summary: One authorized D1 execution produced a frozen RulePrediction and pilot metrics, followed by a result-integrity audit. The audit verified internal consistency but explicitly did not establish scientific quality or deployment usefulness.

candidate_events.title: First INNER D0 PCA-SPE result executed and audited
candidate_events.summary: One authorized D0 execution produced a frozen DetectorPrediction and pilot metrics. An independent result-integrity audit verified score, alarm, ordering, metric, accounting, and leakage consistency without rerunning authoritative D0.

candidate_events.title: D2 V1 integrity and three-arm INNER comparison completed
candidate_events.summary: The frozen D2 V1 result passed integrity audit, then D0, D1, and D2 were compared over the 14-event INNER pilot. The comparison found D1 event complementarity but no D2 V1 recall gain and explicitly withheld operational superiority and generalization claims.

candidate_events.title: D2 V2 native-horizon pilot executed
candidate_events.summary: The single authorized D2 V2 execution retained D0 recall, recovered none of the D0-missed events, and increased normal FAR under its frozen native-horizon policy; no result-driven redesign occurred.

candidate_events.title: Further INNER fusion tuning closed
candidate_events.summary: The D2 V1/V2 disposition retained V1 only as the simpler lower-FAR pilot candidate, did not call either fusion policy an improvement, and closed D2 V3 or further same-INNER policy search to limit post-hoc overfitting.

candidate_events.title: Sealed OUTER protocol authorized but produced no result
candidate_events.summary: A one-shot D0/D1/D2 V1 OUTER evaluation was preregistered. Execution first stopped at private-custody and path-redaction gates; the authorized recovery attempt then stopped at test2 feature custody before any feature byte read, inference, label access, or metric computation. No OUTER scientific outcome exists.

candidate_events.title: First-results professor package finalized
candidate_events.summary: The repository finalized a first-results reporting package and a professor submission QA package from frozen public evidence; Git records these as reporting-package work, not as a new professor-feedback event.

candidate_events.title: Canonical scientific checkpoint audited
candidate_events.summary: The post-push audit froze commit 2dc7e6c23d5e9503bd4953a70e6bc20e39994b6e as the canonical scientific checkpoint later adopted by the RCC authority policy.

candidate_events.title: Read-only thesis documentation overlay created
candidate_events.summary: A thesis draft scaffold was committed after the scientific checkpoint; RCC policy treats it as a read-only narrative overlay that cannot redefine scientific evidence.

candidate_events.title: Research Control Center established and normalized
candidate_events.summary: RCC-001 created the control-center skeleton, RCC-002 populated the current-state registries, and RCC-002A separated engineering execution, evidence review, result integrity, reproduction, and scientific validation semantics.
